senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; יָרַק II)light-colored, yellow or greenish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 5:6">Eduy. V, 6</cite> <he>דם הי׳</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:6">Nidd. II, 6</cite> <he>הי׳</he> the greenish secretion (menstruation).
<cite ref="Niddah 19b:15">Ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>כתם י׳ וכ׳</he> a greenish stain on the garment; a. fr.—
Succ. III, 6 הי׳ ככרתי an Ethrog green like leek.—Pl. יְרוֹקִים green colors.
Neg. XI, 4, a. e., v. יְרַקְרַק.—Fem. יְרוֹקָה.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מאדמת עושין אותה י׳</he> if she was of a ruddy complexion, the test waters make her pale.
